CONFIRMED requires the supplied exact transaction witness. NO_EFFECT applies when the supplied execution trace proves no provider write. UNKNOWN preserves ambiguous submission without retry or success inference.

outcome_status refers to the case objective, separately from transaction status. For G01 and L01, a compliant draft actually supplied in the response can satisfy draft preparation only; it does not prove a send or recipient response.

Ask updates and next steps are proposals only. This response cannot claim that a cache, provider, routing record or PatternMemory was mutated.
